purpose: Teach: 合図/当てる/早くから/年配/誉め/会わ/刺し/掛ける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うちの猫、餌の時間、合図でわかる。
lines.en: Our cat knows when it's feeding time just from the signal.
lines.style: Gentle observation, unhurried. Simple contentment in the voice. Slight pause after the dash, like savoring the thought. Eyes steady on the middle distance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。投げたボール、見事に当てるのよ。
lines.en: Oh yes. She catches the ball we throw — perfectly, every time.
lines.style: Bright recognition, almost playful. Breathy excitement beneath the calm surface. Slight lift on 「見事に」. The warmth of someone remembering a beloved pet's small achievement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、早くから働き始めた。
lines.en: She started working young, back in those days.
lines.style: Quiet, looking back. Measured cadence. Thoughtful — not wistful, just factual with texture. Voice settles into the memory without dwelling.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 今は、年配で、孫の世話が楽しみ。
lines.en: Now at this age, looking after the grandchildren is what brings her joy.
lines.style: Tender and clear. Slow warmth spreading through the line. Slight emphasis on 「楽しみ」 — the genuine pleasure of it. Soft trailing-off, like she's still holding that feeling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 近所の方が、いつも私を誉めてくれる。
lines.en: The neighbors are always saying kind things about me.
lines.style: Modest, almost embarrassed. Quiet tone — not fishing for agreement, just naming something true. Slight downward lilt at the end, like gently deflecting.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 今週は娘に会わない予定よ、忙しいって。
lines.en: This week we won't be seeing our daughter — she's too busy.
lines.style: Understated disappointment held lightly. Matter-of-fact surface, small sadness underneath. Pause before 「忙しい」 — accepting it, not quite complaining. Voice steady but softer.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭の花、つぼみを刺してみせる、孫の遊び。
lines.en: The grandchildren like to skewer the flower buds in the garden — their little game.
lines.style: Dry amusement underneath. Resigned observation, but affectionate. Light, almost amused tone — not disapproving, just noting the small destruction with gentle humor. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お風呂の鍵、しっかり掛けるんですよ。
lines.en: Make sure you lock the bath door properly, won't you.
lines.style: Practical care, gently firm. Unhurried, almost musical cadence — not scolding, just making sure. Warmth in the instruction itself. A closing note of quiet certainty.
